Runtime.phase-A: Node.js 20 LTS (electron-vite build), Electron 30 LTS (app runtime)
Runtime.phase-B: Rust 1.75+ (Tauri backend), system WKWebView on macOS / WebView2 on Windows / webkit2gtk on Linux

Language.phase-B: Rust (backend) + TypeScript (frontend), JavaScript legacy retained only in src/muya/

Framework.phase-A: Vue 3.x (migrated from Vue 2 via PR #4001) + electron-vite

dep.name: objc2
dep.purpose: FFI bridge to NSSpellChecker on macOS

Composition API used by PR #4001; avoid Vue 2 patterns

tool.name: workspace
tool.note: Upstream uses yarn; do not migrate to pnpm in Phase A to minimize diff

tool.name: linter
tool.note: Retain from upstream; migrate to 9.x only if flat config needed

tool.name: test-runner-renderer
tool.note: Phase A keeps existing; Phase B adds cargo test for Rust modules and Playwright over Tauri WebDriver

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and contract checks close to the module

wave-level.focus: Checks merged surfaces touched by the wave; no full e2e

phase-level.command-smoke-install: brew install --cask marktext && open -a MarkText && sleep 2 && pgrep -f MarkText
phase-level.focus: Full regression: CommonMark/GFM specs, unit, e2e, plus fresh-macOS install smoke test

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer fakes over mocks. Filesystem operations use tempdirs (node:fs temp / tempfile crate). No network in unit tests. Tauri commands tested via tauri::test harness.
Testing.regression-policy: Every PR merge must keep test/specs/commonMark and test/specs/gfm fully green; a red spec blocks the merge commit in Phase-A1.

Observability.logger-phase-a: electron-log 4.x (existing), with structured JSON backend enabled
Observability.logger-phase-b: tracing + tracing-subscriber (JSON format in release, pretty in dev)
Observability.required-fields: correlationId (uuid per user action), actorId (user session id), module, event, duration_ms where relevant
Observability.redaction: Never log: file contents, clipboard contents, absolute home-relative paths in shareable artifacts, keychain values. Log file paths only relative to workspace root or redacted to basename when outside.
Observability.no-telemetry: No outbound network logging. All logs are local-only.

DeliveryShape.shape-phase-a: Electron 30 app, single main process + renderer(s), installed via Homebrew cask to /Applications/Mark.app. Ad-hoc signed. Footprint target: < 120 MB.
DeliveryShape.shape-phase-b: Tauri v2 app, Rust backend + Vue 3 WebView. Same distribution channel (Homebrew cask, same tap, same cask name `mark` — version bump triggers upgrade). Footprint target: < 30 MB.
DeliveryShape.release-cadence: v1.0 after Phase-A4. v1.x patch releases as stabilization follows. v2.0 after Phase-B4.
DeliveryShape.fork-repo: https://github.com/xronocode/mark (fork of marktext/marktext; default branch `main` mirrors upstream `develop` at time of fork; working branch `modernize`)
DeliveryShape.ci-os-matrix: macos-14 (arm64) and macos-13 (x86_64) are blocking; ubuntu-latest and windows-latest run with `continue-on-error: true`.
DeliveryShape.signing-strategy: ad-hoc only (`codesign --force --deep --sign - Mark.app`); cask postflight `xattr -cr /Applications/Mark.app` strips quarantine.
